pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are irregularly polygonal with serrated perimeters and soft pixel gradients at the edges. Tonal density is non-uniform, showing darker brown borders and lighter tan internal regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream negative-space pathways form a complex topological graph with frequent 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is variable, maintaining continuity across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dorsal mane displays a continuous 1D serrated contour against the background. The silhouette consists of high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks representing hair bundles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep vertical skin fold or anatomical indentation is visible posterior to the shoulder, creating a localized high-contrast shadow zone.
other_distinctive_markers: A red-billed oxpecker (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) is perched on the posterior flank near the base of the tail.
